The conditional topDesWin assembly is proved through the congruence budget and exact metric-transport premise. Historical graph edges are preserved; graph acyclicity and claim counts are not treated as certificates of global closure.

tex_front_summary:
\textbf{What version 0.23 achieves.} Three complete chains replace
several scattered local frontiers. HP gives an elementary proof of the
literal polynomial highest-weight theorem, absolute irreducibility,
classification and descent, reaching the full original-field weight
supplier. VW proves the entire cohomological-window assembly from three
explicit deep suppliers, including fixed-pair rescaling. WB proves every
character/scalar step from the actual arithmetic gap to the positive
prime window and joins the already complete analytic endpoint. DA records
the remaining AND/OR obligations and proves the finite uniform family
join. The actual arithmetic gap/family, deep cohomology, genuine
theta/local installation and global metric/spectral comparisons remain.
This is \textbf{a partial human reconstruction; the full human-readable
proof of RH and Dirichlet GRH is not yet complete}.
